entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The coastal province of Innistrad, known for fog, port towns, trade and hidden dark arts.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane on which Nephalia is one of four main provinces.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: The largest and most industrialized port city in Nephalia, at the mouth of the Silburlind River.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A fog-shrouded port town in Nephalia where the Nebelgast is thickest.

entities.name: Drunau
entities.description: A small port town known for artisans, trade and a secretive vampire presence, overlooked by Stromkirk Keep.

entities.name: The Nebelgast
entities.description: The persistent sea mist along Nephalia's coast that leads geists from wrecks ashore.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose church holds authority over Innistrad.

entities.name: Skiltfolk
entities.description: A band of mercenary warriors and shield-bearers hired out to merchants and travelers.

entities.name: Stromkirk vampires
entities.description: Vampires who tolerate and profit from forbidden trades in Nephalia, with a military outpost at Stromkirk Keep.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Vampire whose ancestral seat is Stromkirk Manor.

entities.name: Kralmar
entities.description: A monstrous kraken-like sea creature worshipped by a human cult in Nephalia.

entities.name: Ramag
entities.description: Leader of the cultists of Rivstalt.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Built the cryptolith temple called the Drownyard to call Emrakul to the plane.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi called to the plane by the Drownyard temple.

entities.name: The Drownyard
entities.description: The cryptolith temple built by Nahiri, in a cove riddled with shipwrecks.

entities.name: The Erdwal
entities.description: A vast network of underground trenches connecting Nephalia's major cities, now home to brigands and a black market.

entities.name: Rivstalt
entities.description: A remote coastal village whose cultists appease the Kralmar with blood sacrifices.

entities.name: Lake Zhava
entities.description: A highland lake said to harbor the Gitrog monster.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A reclusive necro-alchemist and skaberen living in Ulm.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Collaborator of Ludevic who oversees Ludevic's Laboratory when he is away.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Later resident of the Engelturm.

entities.name: Jeleva
entities.description: Vampire who lairs in an opulent mansion near Havengul, feeding on the secrets and blood of mages.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The period when evil and madness spread across Innistrad and Avacyn's church turned on the people.

events.summary: During the Travails, Avacyn's church turned against Nephalians, dragging away the accused and executing them in the Elgaud Grounds.
events.quote: And Avacyn's church turned against the people of Nephalia, dragging away those who were accused of giving offense to the angels and executing them in the blood-soaked Elgaud Grounds.

relations.note: One of the three major port towns
relations.quote: The three major port towns — Havengul, Drunau, and Selhoff — form the heart of Innistrad's commerce

relations.note: Built the cryptolith temple to call Emrakul
relations.quote: The Drownyard - the cryptolith temple built by Nahiri to call Emrakul to the plane
Under the fervent leadership of Ramag
